tool.name: KMA Index Builder
tool.command: mkdir -p '${out_file.extra_files_path}'/index_folder && kma_index -i '$fasta' -o '${out_file.extra_files_path}'/index_folder/index ## index options -k $k -k_t $k_t -k_i $k_i -ML $ML -ht $ht -hq $hq && index_digest=\$({ printf '%s\n' 'kma_version=@TOOL_VERSION@' 'k=$k' 'k_t=$k_t' 'k_i=$k_i' 'ML=$ML' 'ht=$ht' 'hq=$hq' && sha256sum '$fasta' | cut -d ' ' -f 1; } | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1) && sed "s/__KMA_INDEX_DIGEST__/\$index_digest/g" '$dmjson' > dm.json

param.label: kmer size used for indexing the database.
kmer size used to identify template candidates when running KMA.
kmer size used when performing alignments between two sequences.

param.name: name
param.label: Name for index
param.help: Choose a name that describes the indexed sequence and possibly any non-default indexing parameters.

tool.help:
**Data manager for building an index for the kma aligner**
Runs the kma index command on the input sequence with the chosen options.
.. class:: infomark
You may want to capture details about the reference sequence and any non-default indexing parameters in the name of the index so that users have a better idea what they are selecting for tool runs.
